model_annotations.German: The chart illustrates per-layer (per “block”) sensitivity values for the model “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B,” with each block shown as a single vertical bar whose color indicates whether that block is assigned “4‑Fbit” (blue) or “2‑Fbit” (green). The horizontal axis contains the categories as block indices labeled “Block Index,” running sequentially from 0 to 47 with labeled ticks at 0, 11, 23, 35, and 47. The vertical axis is labeled “Sensitivity” and uses a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels shown at approximately \(10^{-5}\) and \(10^{-4}\) (and dashed horizontal gridlines aligned to these ticks); bar heights span from a few \(\times 10^{-6}\) up to a few \(\times 10^{-4}\). From block 0 through the late 20s, the bars are predominantly green (2‑Fbit) and range from roughly \(3\times10^{-6}\) to about \(4\times10^{-5}\), including an early bar near block 0 around \(1.5\times10^{-5}\), a low point around blocks ~5–7 near \(3–4\times10^{-6}\), and several mid-range bars around blocks ~10–18 near \(1\times10^{-5}\). Around the high 20s into the 30s, several blue (4‑Fbit) bars appear with sensitivities on the order of \(5\times10^{-5}\) to just under \(1\times10^{-4}\), interspersed with occasional green bars in the 30s and early 40s (e.g., green bars around the mid-to-high \(10^{-5}\) range). In the final portion (low-to-mid 40s through 47), the sequence is mostly blue (4‑Fbit) with the tallest bars reaching roughly \(2–3\times10^{-4}\) near the last few indices. The bars are not grouped or stacked (one bar per index), they follow the natural numeric order of block index rather than being sorted by value, and there are no special outlines or numeric annotations beyond the color legend in the upper-left.
